hook: Bolt the robot dances exactly what the picture cards say. Make a dance card by card, then play the Fix-It Show: watch Dot do the real dance, see Bolt trip on the wrong card, and fix the bug together.
outcome: Follow and build a sequence of steps in order, and find and fix the one wrong step (a bug) in a short algorithm
